title: Crispy Greek Gyro Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make wrap filled with crispy gyro meat, tangy feta cheese, and fresh herbs.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Cook the gyro meat for 3-4 minutes per side, or until crispy and cooked through.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
Slice the cooked gyro meat into thin strips.
Crumble the feta cheese into a bowl.
Slice the tomato and red onion into thin strips.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and olive oil.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a layer of the lemon juice mixture on the warmed pita bread, then adding the sliced gyro meat, feta cheese, tomato, red onion, and cilantro.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
